title: Care of HIV Patients in Long-Term Care Facilities: A Growing Concern and a Call to Action
content: As people living with HIV (PLWH) are living longer, they face increased risks of chronic diseases and may require care in nursing homes (NH). Given the complexity of the general NH resident population, NH staff may lack specialized training to provide optimal HIV care, leading to care gaps. This report highlights six cases of PLWH hospitalized from NHs, illustrating these gaps and the need for systemic changes in education and protocols for HIV care in NHs. Addressing these gaps is crucial for improving outcomes for this aging and vulnerable population.
